mutations.label: the night stops asking what the emulator verified: the step is commented out rather than deleted, so every name in the file survives and only a test that reads STEPS rather than TEXT can notice (#740)
mutations.replace:
# - name: What the emulator verified against every plan
      #   if: always()
      #   run: sudo tools/conformance/guard.sh verification http://127.0.0.1:4599

mutations.label: the step stops being `if: always()`, so a suite that already failed hides the claims of the very run that went wrong
mutations.find:
- name: What the emulator verified against every plan
        if: always()
mutations.replace:
- name: What the emulator verified against every plan
        if: always() == false
